denominator: 11 programme entity classes; examples scoped to named panel assignments, not a semantic census
competing_explanation: A property can be text-only or task-specific rather than an independently reusable element.
confidence_rationale: Proposed ontology grounded in bounded case evidence; no semantic label agreement or complete library.

categories.definition: Persistent subject identity; names/appearance alone never merge IDs.
categories.boundary: Age is a variant axis; preserve declared facial identifiers.

categories.definition: Garment/footwear identity independently bound to a wearer.
categories.boundary: Changing wardrobe need not create a new character.
Pose state differs from subject identity; package fulfilment unknown.

categories.definition: Persistent setting identity; literal environment metadata mapped only with evidence.
categories.boundary: Time/weather/lighting are state axes, not automatically new locations.

categories.definition: Spatial arrangement or blockout binding distinct from surface treatment.
categories.boundary: Input described as blockout; media geometry remains unobservable.

categories.definition: Persistent object identity, with changed-property derivatives kept separate.
categories.boundary: Logo/panel changes infer a derivative, not approval.

categories.definition: Surface/substance/wear specification attachable to an entity.
categories.boundary: Wear/tape are named changes, not verified image contents.

categories.definition: Scoped colour specification or reference role.
categories.boundary: Colour authority can differ from composition authority.
Do not infer illumination from time of day or attached media.

categories.definition: Rendering/style constraint or explicitly assigned reference role.
categories.boundary: Preserved art-style wording does not establish an independent approved style asset.

categories.definition: Disclosed speaker/voice identity and source recording, if evidenced.
categories.boundary: No scoped Study 03 panel voice-reference example established; do not infer one from audio jobs.

rules: Identity is a film-scoped persistent key, not a category/name/URL match.
Variant describes a named state delta under an identity claim; version is a provenance-bearing representation revision.
Different outputs or v2 names alone establish neither variant equivalence nor a version edge.
Property roles can be independent elements or claims attached to an element/task; do not force every adjective into an entity.
Keep source category and interpreted kind separately; auto and ip_verified labels remain literal metadata.
